gloss: to be moistened; to profit; to be enriched

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {潤|うるお}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be moistened; to become moist
definitions.explanation: for something to become wet or moist, often used for skin or eyes

definitions.gloss: to profit; to benefit; to be enriched
definitions.explanation: to gain financially or materially from something

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大地|だいち}→大地：12187_daichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潤|うるお}った。
examples.english: The earth was moistened by the rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{目元|めもと}→目元：23407_memoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潤|うるお}う。
examples.english: This lotion moisturizes the area around the eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潤|うるお}った。
⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{懐|ふところ}→懐：12631_futokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潤|うるお}った。
examples.english: The economy improved and my wallet got fatter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{副業|ふくぎょう}→副業：08479_fukugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潤|うるお}うようになった。
examples.english: My life became more comfortable thanks to my side job.

notes:
SENSE 1 - MOISTURE:
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潤|うるお}う (skin becomes moisturized)
- ⟦{潤|うるお}い→潤い：08250_uruoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (moisturized skin)
- Common in cosmetics advertising

SENSE 2 - PROFIT/ENRICHMENT:
- ⟦{懐|ふところ}→懐：12631_futokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潤|うるお}う (one's pocket becomes fatter)
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潤|うるお}う (life becomes comfortable)

TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- Related transitive: ⟦{潤|うるお}す→潤す：08249_uruosu⟧ (to moisten, to enrich)
- Related noun: ⟦{潤|うるお}い→潤い：08250_uruoi⟧ (moisture, richness)
